Headline: Bus Substitution Between Jefferson Park and Harlem (O’Hare branch) Stations
ShortDescription: Shuttle buses will replace Blue Line service between Jefferson Park and Harlem (O’Hare branch).

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?
Shuttle buses will replace rail service between Jefferson Park and Harlem (O’Hare branch).

Trains will operate between O’Hare and Harlem (O’Hare branch), and between Jefferson Park, downtown, and Forest Park.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?
CTA is performing track maintenance for a safer, smoother commute. This work is funded via the Northern Illinois Transit Authority (NITA) Act.

Bus shuttle boarding locations
Station Direction Shuttle stop
Jefferson Park to Harlem in bus terminal, at stop (A)
Harlem to Jefferson Park in bus terminal, south bays near Harlem Ave

Headline: Temporary Reroute near 75th/Racine
ShortDescription: #75 74th/75th buses temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near 75th/Racine.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#75 74th/75th buses temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near 75th/Racine.

Eastbound #75 74th/75th buses rerouted via 74th, Continue to Racine over the regular route. 

Westbound #75 74th/75th buses rerouted via 74th, Continue to Loomis over the regular route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #7 Harrison Temporary Reroute near Harrison/Kilpatrick
ShortDescription: 7 Harrison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Harrison/Kilpatrick.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#7 Harrison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Harrison/Kilpatrick.

Westbound buses will operate via Congress, Kostner, Jackson, Cicero, Harrison and over normal route.

Eastbound buses will operate via Harrison, Cicero, Jackson, Kostner, 5th Ave, Harrison and over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Brown Line Trains bypassing Montrose
ShortDescription: Brown Line trains are running, but not stopping at Montrose due to police activity.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Brown Line trains are running, but not stopping at Montrose due to police activity.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Also consider using nearby Irving Park station for Brown Line train service. 

We apologize for this inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
